items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Garland Bottle was, and Glen Graves, Castle Lomas, we were splitting the sessions up.

ctx.x: Were they all made one afternoon, one day, or whenever it was?

Well I tell you, Garland Bottle was, and Glen Graves, Castle Lomas, we were splitting the sessions up. We'd go in in the morning, and then one of them would come in the evening. And then the next morning one of them would come in and we'd go in the evening. And that's how that was. But we made, then we made a recording under the Levin Longes with Chick Bullock.
Well you made those, some of those.
